parsed.name: 电压表校准系统
parsed.description: 用于实验室中对待测设备电压测量通道进行校准与核查的校准系统。该系统通常配合可编程电源、数字万用表和待校准设备使用，通过多个校准点与检查点完成电压表或模数转换读数的校准、平均测量和结果验证。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory calibration system used to calibrate and verify the voltage measurement channel of a device under test. It is typically used together with a programmable power supply, a digital multimeter, and the DUT, applying multiple calibration and check points to calibrate a voltage meter or ADC-based reading, perform averaged measurements, and verify the result.

actions.description: 连接用于提供校准电压的电源。
actions.description_en: Connect the power supply used to provide the calibration voltage.

actions.description: 连接作为参考测量仪表的数字万用表。
actions.description_en: Connect the digital multimeter used as the reference measurement instrument.
Connect the device under test to be calibrated.

actions.description: 获取用于线性校准的电压校准点。
actions.description_en: Get the voltage calibration points used for linear calibration.

actions.description: 按照设定的校准点执行电压表校准。
actions.description_en: Perform voltage meter calibration using the defined calibration points.

actions.description: 获取用于校准核查的检查点。
actions.description_en: Get the check points used for calibration verification.

actions.description: 检查电压校准后的测量结果是否符合预期。
actions.description_en: Check whether the voltage measurement after calibration matches the expected result.

actions.description: 进行多次测量并计算平均值，可选用模数转换读数。
actions.description_en: Perform repeated measurements and calculate an average value, optionally using ADC readings.
